 Follow Sportstar’s live updates, scores and highlights from the UEFA Champions League 2026-27 league-phase match between Cesc Fabregas’ Como and Michael Carrick’s Manchester United at the Stadio Giuseppe Sinigaglia in Italy on Wednesday. 
 TEAM NEWS 
 Como - Playing XI: Butez; Yan Couto, Ramon, Kempf, Valle; Milla, Perrone; Da Cunha, Paz, Baturina; Douvikas. 
 Subs: Ginelli, Sanchez, Caqueret, Dossena, Kaiki Bruno, Ricci, Smolcic, Liberali.
 Manchester United - Playing XI: Lammens; Dalot, Maguire, De Ligt, Mazraoui; Andrey Santos, Tielemans; Matheus Cunha, Bruno Fernandes, Mount; Mbeumo.
 Subs: Darlow, Heaton, Zirkzee, Diallo, Baleba, Thompson, Lacey, J Fletcher, T Fletcher, Amass, Kamason, Armer.
